headline: ヒト脳のtau線維の形は、マウス脳の中でそのまま受け継がれる
subhead: アルツハイマー病と大脳皮質基底核変性症の線維をクライオ電顕で比べた
target_en: Tau filaments (mouse brain, AD- and CBD-seeded)

summary.question: プリオンのように、tau 線維の形（株）が別の個体の脳に伝わっても保たれるかは、実証されていなかった。
summary.approach: アルツハイマー病（AD）または大脳皮質基底核変性症（CBD）の脳から取ったtau線維を野生型マウスの脳に注入し、できた線維をクライオ電顕で調べた。
summary.result: マウス自身のtauが、AD種では3.6 Å、CBD種では3.4 Åの構造の線維をつくり、種のヒト線維と同じ構造だった。
summary.learned: tau線維は鋳型にそって増える性質（テンプレート播種）で株の構造を保ち、マウスは機構の研究に使える可能性がある。
summary.open: tau種の注入で臨床症状が出るか、毒性が別の段階で起こるかは分かっていない。

question.quote: However, a central pillar of the prion hypothesis, that strains retain their structural identity upon transmission, has not been demonstrated.

approach.quote: Here we show that the injection of tau filaments from the brains of individuals with Alzheimer’s disease or corticobasal degeneration into the brains of wild-type mice leads to the seeded assembly of amyloid filaments made of mouse tau with the same structures as those of the seeds.

result.quote: In mice injected with AD seeds, most of the filaments (83%) were paired helical filaments (PHFs), for which we calculated a reconstruction to a resolution of 3.6 Å.
result.section: Seeded filaments identical to the seeds

result.quote: We reconstructed the singlets to a resolution of 3.4 Å.
result.section: Seeded filaments identical to the seeds

learned.quote: Thus, we show that, similar to prion strains, tau filaments propagate through templated seeding, and that the mouse is a suitable model to study the molecular mechanisms by which distinct tau folds drive disease-specific pathology in the brain.

open.quote: It therefore remains unknown whether tau seed propagation and downstream toxicity occur in two separate phases, as has been suggested for prions38.

highlights.text: AD 種を注入したマウスでは線維の83%が対らせん状線維（PHF）だった。この構造はヒト AD 脳のアルツハイマー型の折りたたみと重なり、原子位置のずれ（RMSD）は0.906 Åだった。

evidence.quote: This structure was identical (with a root mean square deviation for all non-hydrogen atoms of 0.906 Å) to the Alzheimer fold from AD brains30,31.
evidence.section: Seeded filaments identical to the seeds

highlights.text: CBD 種を注入した場合は、74%が1本のプロトフィラメントで、ヒトの I 型 CBD 線維と同じ構造（RMSD 0.576 Å）だった。2本組の線維は10 Å までしか解けず、II 型 CBD 線維の可能性がある。

evidence.quote: A reconstruction of the doublets, to a resolution of 10 Å, suggested that they may be type II CBD filaments.
evidence.section: Seeded filaments identical to the seeds

highlights.text: ヒトとマウスの tau は線維の中心部分で配列が同じなので、種の壁がない。注入したヒト tau は1週間後には検出できなくなり、見つかった線維はマウス tau でできていた。

evidence.quote: The human tau seeds were visible by staining immediately after injection, but they could no longer be detected after 1 week.

Human and mouse sequences are identical within the ordered cores of tau filaments from human brains, indicating that there may be no species barrier for the transmission of human disease-specific tau strains to the mice.

lab_notes.purification: 脳のサルコシル不溶画分を調製した。
lab_notes.sample_prep: AD または CBD 患者脳由来の種を、6〜18週齢の野生型マウスの線条体に注入し、9〜12か月後の脳から線維を抽出。グリッドは Quantifoil R1.2/1.3 で、Vitrobot Mark IV で凍結。
lab_notes.data_collection: Titan Krios（300 kV）、Falcon4i、Selectris-X エネルギーフィルター。線量は40 e/Å2。

evidence.quote: Sarkosyl-insoluble pellets were prepared from about 0.5 g tissue, as described in ref. 50.

Three microlitres of sarkosyl-insoluble fractions from wild-type mice that had been injected bilaterally with AD or CBD seeds 9–12 months earlier were applied to glow-discharged (Edwards S150B; Edwards High Vacuum International) holey carbon grids (Quantifoil Au R1.2/1.3, 300 mesh) that were subjected to plunge-freezing in liquid ethane using a Vitrobot Mark IV (Thermo Fisher Scientific) at 100% humidity and 4 °C.
Cryo-EM images were acquired on a Titan Krios electron microscope operated at 300 kV, equipped with a Falcon4i direct electron detector (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and a Selectris-X energy filter.
Images were recorded at a dose of 40 electrons per Å2 using EPU software (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

editor_notes: PDB 29OS（AD 種）と 29OU（CBD 種）が公開済み。first_structure の判定はサイトが決める。CBD の2本組は10 Å で構造は未確定と書いた。
